notes: Not automated: [Main] If your Leader's type includes "Whitebeard Pirates", reveal 1 card from the top of your deck. If that card is a Character card with a type including {Whitebeard Pirates} and a cost of 9 or less, you may play that card. If you do, that Character gains [Rush] during this turn.
